[
  {
    "id": "control-occlusion",
    "title": "Input labels overlap active control zones",
    "what": "In the gameplay screen, the 'STANCE' and 'TECHNIQUE' text labels and move-lists (e.g., 'step', 'jump') are rendered directly over the joystick touch areas.",
    "why": "Visual clutter in the primary interaction zone creates cognitive load and obscures the physical boundaries of the twin-stick controls during high-intensity combat.",
    "how": "Move the move-list labels (step, jump, etc.) above the joystick circles or integrate them into the outer ring of the joystick UI."
  },
  {
    "id": "fighter-centering",
    "title": "Vertical composition wastes screen real estate",
    "what": "In the 'QUALIFIER' and gameplay screens, the fighters are positioned in the center/lower-middle, leaving a massive void of empty dojo floor between the fighters and the bottom HUD.",
    "why": "On a portrait phone, this pushes the action too far from the player's thumbs and makes the characters appear small, reducing the impact of the photoreal sprites.",
    "how": "Shift the camera angle down or move the fighter sprites lower in the frame to reduce the gap between the feet and the control panel."
  },
  {
    "id": "hit-feedback-visibility",
    "title": "Low-contrast hit sparks",
    "what": "In the 'IPPON' screenshot, the yellow hit-sparks on the fighter's head are thin and blend into the warm, volumetric lighting of the background.",
    "why": "The 'Ippon' is the most critical moment of the game; if the visual feedback is too subtle, the player may miss the exact point of impact.",
    "how": "Add a high-contrast white core to the sparks and a brief, full-screen radial blur or chromatic aberration hit-stop effect."
  },
  {
    "id": "hud-hierarchy",
    "title": "Scoreboard lacks visual prominence",
    "what": "The top HUD (Asmongold 0 - 30 - Hasanabi) uses thin, small typography that blends into the dark background.",
    "why": "Players need to glance at their score and time instantly; the current thin font requires too much focus to read during a fight.",
    "how": "Increase the font weight of the scores and add a subtle dark semi-transparent backing plate to the top HUD to separate it from the background light.",
  },
  {
    "id": "menu-contrast",
    "title": "Settings checkboxes lack active state clarity",
    "what": "In the 'SETTINGS' screen, the checkboxes for 'Reduced motion', 'High contrast', etc., are dark grey on a dark brown background.",
    "why": "It is visually difficult to tell at a glance which settings are currently enabled versus disabled.",
    "how": "Change the 'checked' state to a bright gold fill (matching the 'FIGHT' button) to provide a clear binary visual indicator."
  }
]
